whyItMatters: csharp XML parsing enables entities (DtdProcessing.Parse), so hostile documents read files and probe networks.
actions: Apply DtdProcessing.Prohibit to every XML parser on untrusted input.
Prefer data formats without entity features for new interfaces.
Re-run the scan and confirm no entity-enabling setting remains.
verification: Rescan shows no entity-enabling setting, and XXE probes resolve to nothing.
